description: Execute a local Gene via the Rotifer CLI (rotifer run). The Gene must exist in the local genes/ directory. Returns execution output.

input.description: Input JSON data to pass to the gene

no_sandbox.description: Run without WASM sandbox, Node.js only (default: false). Refused unless the server was launched with --allow=no-sandbox.

trust_unsigned.description: Allow Node.js execution for Cloud-installed genes (default: false). Refused unless the server was launched with --allow=trust-unsigned.

name: run_gene
